title: High-fidelity EDSR in Si/SiGe Wiggle Wells
summary: Si/SiGe quantum wells that incorporate Ge concentration oscillations, known as long-period Wiggle Wells, have been shown to enhance the Dresselhaus spin-orbit coupling of conduction-band electrons. Such intrinsic spin-orbit coupling is desirable when performing spin-qubit gate operations based on electric dipole spin resonance (EDSR) because it eliminates the need for external micromagnets.
